rules.rule: Sunu: N/A singular -u, G/D singular -a; N/G/A plural -a, D plural -um. The vowel is short. Cook records variation -u/-o outside genitives and dative plural, and later a-stem sunes/sunas. These are valid documented alternatives, not the selected target or an invitation to assign other u-stem lemmas.

Geðeahtend follows the masculine -end agent-noun pattern, not the inflecting present participle. Selected singular geðeahtend/-es/-e/zero; plural N/A geðeahtend, G geðeahtendra, D geðeahtendum. N/A plural -e and rarer -as are documented alternatives.

Rīce has singular rīce/rīces/rīce/rīce and plural rīcu/rīca/rīcum/rīcu. The lexical -e disappears before the case ending. Cook explicitly allows inserted i/e in the plural after c/g: rīciu/rīcia etc.; these are valid unselected variants.

Use explicit diagnostic stems: angel→angl-, fōdor→fōdr-, but ðyrel retains e. Cræft retains æ before its consonant cluster. Ealdormann follows mann in the final member: dat.sg and N/Apl ealdormęnn. Strong -e nouns replace final e before endings; -nes has -ness-. Smiððe/sīde are weak feminines; fyrspearca/trēowwyrhta/scēowyrhta/wyrhta/cęmpa weak masculines.

Behēfe is an -e adjective: replace lexical e with endings; selected strong feminine nominative singular and neuter N/A plural behēfu. Welig and manig retain medial i in the selected full paradigms and take -u in those cells (weligu/manigu). Wīs is heavy and lacks -u there. Wīsra adds comparative -r- without umlaut and declines weakly; genitive plural wīsra reduces doubled r beside s under Wright §259.3, as earlier lēofra does beside f. Strong feminine N/A plural -e is valid alongside selected -a; other variant cells require their own cited evidence rather than free analogical substitution. Manig is productive only as ordinary plural attributive many; its singular cells are recognition reference, without assigning many-a or substantival/partitive quantity constructions.

Mass/abstract unassigned plural senses remain outside independent production even though complete formal number paradigms are recorded. Hlæst wares and bęlg bellows are selected as plural; singular counterparts are recognition reference and do not add an unassigned singular sense. No source-supplied history is erased by a new production milestone.
